fields.summary_ko.0: SK hynix Inc (NASDAQ:SKHY) rose 3.8% to $127.30 in U.S. pre-market trading following Nvidia's strong quarterly results and increased long-term memory supply commitments.
fields.summary_ko.1: Nvidia increased supply commitments from $279 billion to $390 billion, primarily driven by multi-year memory supply procurement, providing positive signals for SK hynix as an HBM supplier.
